_comment: WO-4 paired device pilot, approved explicitly by the owner (2026-10-05): cell 0b
exactly as wo4-cell0b-pilot-6pct.json, seed 42, trained on the Mac's GPU (mps).
NOT A RESULT OF RECORD; MEASURED TO PROPOSE THE D6 TOLERANCE. ADR 0020's 2026-10-05
amendment requires the accepted CPU-vs-GPU difference in warm recall@500 to be stated
before any non-CPU run counts; no tolerance is stated yet, so this run is the
measurement that proposes one. Its recall is not cited anywhere but its run record.
Training runs on mps; the trained weights are moved to the CPU before anything is
scored, so every number it reports -- the probe, the per-pass holdout diagnostic and
the final evaluation -- is computed on the CPU. Same seed: the negatives come from the
same NumPy stream, but dropout draws from the mps generator, which on the CPU run
shares the CPU generator with the shuffle, so from pass 2 the two runs see examples
in different orders. Recorded: the speed-up per pass (CPU epoch_train_seconds over
mps) and over the whole fit, and the difference in warm recall@500 against the CPU
pilot. Predeclared checks as for the CPU pilot (protocol hash, exact cold recall,
result_status: not a result of record; measured to propose the D6 tolerance
